description: Phase 6 — hold + fade-after-break. Clip starts at frame 0, duration 60 (clipEnd=60). Section break at frame 60 (microseconds 60/30*1_000_000=2_000_000) with fadeSeconds=1.0 (30 frames at 30fps). New semantic: fade-out window is [clipEnd, clipEnd+fadeFrames) = [60, 90). At frame 60 the clip is at full alpha (held last frame), multiplier=1.0. At frame 75 (mid fade-out), multiplier = 1 - 15/30 = 0.5. At frame 89 (last frame in window), multiplier = 1 - 29/30 ~= 0.0333. SeekToFrame avoids the section auto-pause path entirely so we can sample multiplier at exact frames inside the held tail.
